result: If I remember well, what we tried to do on this branch, or at least we should try to do, maybe from lower commits in a separate branch before we start to change to OpenUI, is replace KimiK2 with cursor ACP using Codec Spark 5.3. such a modification exists somewhere in the Git tree, so don't reinvent it. Take inspiration out of it.
